bug_semantics: OpenClaw's ZIP extractor constructed an output path under the extraction directory, checked path and symlink state, and only afterward opened that pathname for truncating/writing. A local attacker able to mutate the extraction tree could replace a checked parent directory with a symlink during that gap, causing an entry such as slot/target.txt to resolve outside the extraction root and clobber the external target. O_NOFOLLOW protected only the final path component; it did not bind parent resolution to the object that had been checked.
flaw_origin: Original feature implementation. Commit 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 first added the production ZIP extractor in src/infra/archive.ts with lexical containment checking followed by mkdir and fs.writeFile(outPath, data). Subsequent streaming and symlink-hardening commits changed the sink but preserved the same check/use separation; in particular 4b226b74f5fd3b106a83a6347fd404172e2fd246 added parent checks and O_NOFOLLOW on the leaf without making parent traversal race-safe.
ai_marker: absent — BIC commit object has no AI author/co-author/Generated-with marker; see evidence
evidence: First-party GHSA-r54r-wmmq-mh84 states the parent-directory symlink-rebind TOCTOU mechanism, affected npm versions <= 2026.3.1, patched versions >= 2026.3.2, and names 7dac9b05dd9d38dd3929637f26fa356fd8bdd107 as the fix.

git show --format=fuller --no-renames 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 -- src/infra/archive.ts shows archive.ts added from /dev/null and extractZip checking path.resolve(...).startsWith(destDir), then running fs.mkdir(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true }) and fs.writeFile(outPath, data).

git log -L 249,260:src/infra/archive.ts 4b226b74f5fd3b106a83a6347fd404172e2fd246^ follows the unsafe writer through 4c7838e3cf0a4d183cd8962a8c02e0f47888c5e5 and d3ee5deb87ee2ad0ab83c92c365611165423cb71 back to the three lines first added by 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079. git log -S'await fs.writeFile(outPath, data)' -- src/infra/archive.ts independently reports 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 as the addition and d3ee5deb87ee2ad0ab83c92c365611165423cb71 as its streaming rewrite.

Direct parent verification: git diff --name-status 5dc87a2ed4cf8bff1c76cddb2a1de76d333f4cc4 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 -- src/infra/archive.ts prints 'A src/infra/archive.ts'; git grep -n -E 'JSZip|extractZip|zip entry|entry\.async|writeFile\(outPath' 5dc87a2ed4cf8bff1c76cddb2a1de76d333f4cc4 -- src finds JSZip only in media tests and no production ZIP extractor/writer.

git show 4b226b74f5fd3b106a83a6347fd404172e2fd246 -- src/infra/archive.ts shows the incomplete hardening lifecycle: assertNoSymlinkTraversal and assertResolvedInsideDestination run before openZipOutputFile, while OPEN_WRITE_FLAGS uses O_TRUNC and only leaf-component O_NOFOLLOW. This preserved the already-existing parent-rebind race rather than introducing it.

git show 7dac9b05dd9d38dd3929637f26fa356fd8bdd107 -- src/infra/archive.ts src/infra/fs-safe.ts shows the closing change: resolve the opened handle's real path, compare file identity, require it inside destinationRealDir, and truncate an existing file only after those checks. Its archive regression test rebinds extractDir/slot to outsideDir after realpath and verifies outside/target.txt remains 'SAFE'.

Release boundary: git tag --contains 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 --list 'v2026.*' begins at v2026.1.16-2 (v2026.1.15 is absent). git tag --contains 7dac9b05dd9d38dd3929637f26fa356fd8bdd107 --list 'v2026.3.*' contains v2026.3.2 and later tags but not v2026.3.1. git rev-parse resolves v2026.3.1 to d76b224e20c790b7223d4075abd087c9576a4661 and v2026.3.2 to 85377a28175695c224f6589eb5c1460841ecd65c.

BIC-only AI check: git cat-file commit 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079 shows one parent, human author and committer 'Peter Steinberger <steipete@gmail.com>', subject 'feat: unify hooks installs and webhooks', and no body, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, or bot identity. The commit object provides no AI marker; no later commit or fix metadata was used for the verdict.
reasoning: The vulnerability existed as soon as production ZIP extraction was introduced: pathname containment was checked separately from the eventual pathname-based write, so a mutable parent could redirect the write. The later stream conversion was a refactor, and the February 21 symlink defense only narrowed static/leaf attacks while retaining the parent-directory race; neither is the root BIC. Line history and -S therefore converge on 3a6ee5ee00176c88aee32bb8bfd543780014c079, whose immediate parent has no production extractor. The advisory's direct fix 7dac9b05dd9d38dd3929637f26fa356fd8bdd107 binds validation to the opened file identity and is present from v2026.3.2, closing the <=2026.3.1 boundary. Because the BIC commit object is human-authored/committed and has no AI attribution or bot signal, the required BIC-only judgment is NOT_AI.
